name: my-ssg-app
description: Demo-style docs app for Codemonster SSG.

scripts.dev: npm run docs:generate && npm run playgrounds:generate && vite
scripts.dev:force: npm run docs:generate && npm run playgrounds:generate && vite --force
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run docs:generate && npm run playgrounds:generate && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite-ssg build
scripts.typecheck: npm run docs:generate && npm run playgrounds:generate && vue-tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
